% A leading "-" is set as a proper minus sign that never breaks across lines.
\def\rhalsign#1#2\relax{\ifx-#1\mbox{\textminus}#2\else#1#2\fi}
\newcommand{\val}[1]{\ifcsname #1\endcsname\expandafter\expandafter\expandafter\rhalsign\csname #1\endcsname\relax\else\textcolor{red}{--}\GenericWarning{}{rhal: missing generated value #1}\fi}
% Paired comparisons: \cmp{Key} -> "8.8 pp [6.1, 11.6]" (mean per-seed difference, 95% bootstrap CI);
% \cmpneg{Key} reads the same comparison the other way round; \pholm{Key} -> "p_Holm = 0.041" / "p_Holm < 0.001".
\newcommand{\ci}[1]{[\val{#1Lo}, \val{#1Hi}]}
\newcommand{\cmp}[1]{\val{#1}\,pp~\ci{#1}}
\newcommand{\cmpneg}[1]{\val{#1Neg}\,pp~[\val{#1NegLo}, \val{#1NegHi}]}
\def\rhalpfloor{$<$0.001}% must match the "<0.001" string written by make_report_tables.py
\newcommand{\pholm}[1]{\ifcsname #1P\endcsname\expandafter\ifx\csname #1P\endcsname\rhalpfloor$p_{\mathrm{Holm}}<0.001$\else$p_{\mathrm{Holm}}=\text{\val{#1P}}$\fi\else$p_{\mathrm{Holm}}=$\,\textcolor{red}{--}\fi}
\newcommand{\rhal}{RobustHFT-AgentLab}
\newcommand{\pp}{\,pp}
\newcommand{\asr}{\mathrm{ASR}}
\DeclareMathOperator{\artanh}{artanh}

% ---- table captions -----------------------------------------------------------------------
% IEEE sets table captions above the table, AAAI below it (the AAAI build says \rhalcapbelowtrue).
% Generated tables call \rhaltable{\caption{...}\label{...}}{<body>} (make_report_tables.py::float_table).
\newif\ifrhalcapbelow
\newcommand{\rhaltable}[2]{\ifrhalcapbelow{#2}\par#1\else#1{#2}\fi}
